metadata.label: Abstract
metadata.value: When finally the dowry is completely transferred, I Wé Cudaiq refuses to become Sawérigading’s wife. The dowry is returned, but after only one day the people of Cina claim that the whole dowry has already been given back. Sawérigading begins a war against Cina and brings Cina under his control. He then transforms himself into a breeze and visits I Wé Cudaiq unnoticed. His twin sister, Wé Tenriabéng, sends the land Malimongeng complete with palace and gardens to earth. Sawérigading marries I Wé Cimpau, queen of Lémpang. Three months later he and I Wé Cudaiq make up and Sawérigading visits her every night for a couple of months.
